sentences.text: Make-up allocation begins when the active flight assignment and available build positions are confirmed.
Baggage Operations Supervisor authorizes release to a make-up position only when the flight remains within its processing window.
Flight Data Gateway maintains the flight identity and departure timing used for make-up planning.
Mosslight assigns bags to active make-up lanes using current zone status.
Velvet records each bag's screening disposition and release state against its flight assignment.
Pier 4 Bag-Drop Unit stages accepted bags for onward processing without changing their flight association.
Induction Tray Conveyor meters bags into the handling stream at a rate that avoids accumulation at the make-up interface.
Primary Crossbelt Sorter separates bags according to their authorized destination and current operating status.
North Gate Scanner verifies readable bag identification before bags proceed toward their assigned build.
South Gate Scanner provides the corresponding verification for bags processed in its coverage area.
Image Resolution Desk uses the exception ticket to confirm an authorized make-up position for an oversize bag.
Secondary Inspection Chute retains bags requiring further examination until the applicable disposition is recorded.
Bag Reconciliation Station uses the Late Transfer Bag Card to reconcile a transfer bag against its intended flight.
Transfer Bag Feeder meters accepted transfer bags into the active handling sequence without bypassing required checks.
East Make-Up Conveyor delivers assigned bags to the designated make-up position at a controlled rate.
West Make-Up Conveyor provides the equivalent delivery function for positions in its operating area.
Carousel 7 Make-Up Unit maintains bag order and position information for its active flight build.
Carousel 7 Make-Up Unit receives the Carousel Release Slip only after its position and flight assignment have been checked.
Airline Ramp Coordinator confirms staffing, equipment availability, and the planned loading sequence before accepting a build for loading.
Outbound Load Control Desk reconciles the completed build against the permitted flight load before departure closeout.
Bag Tag Printer produces replacement identification only when authorized personnel have confirmed the required bag details.
Security Duty Manager resolves release holds that require a security decision before bags can enter a departure build.
Maintenance Technician reports equipment restrictions that affect lane availability or safe bag delivery.
Baggage Operations Supervisor coordinates changes to build priority with airline ground operations and communicates any resulting delivery constraints.
